title: Rare Value Protocol — From Public Fragments to Undiscovered Knowledge
status: research discovery protocol + project synthesis standard
purpose: Make the project valuable by finding defensible relations that are difficult to see from any one source, while distinguishing a discovered bridge or hypothesis from an established fact.

scholarly_origin.summary: Don R. Swanson argued that publicly available fragments can remain effectively undiscovered when they are scattered across disconnected literatures. LBD seeks useful implicit connections by joining separately supported relations.
scholarly_origin.canonical_pattern: A → B and B → C can justify investigating A → C even when no source directly asserts A → C.
scholarly_origin.examples_from_history: Classic LBD work connected previously separated biomedical literatures such as fish oil and Raynaud's disease, and magnesium and migraine, through intermediate mechanisms.

project_translation.A: A project question, symbol, institution, historical event or unresolved pattern.
project_translation.B: A bridge mechanism or structural relation independently documented in both sides.
project_translation.C: A distant literature, tradition, institution, science or historical domain that was not already part of the obvious comparison.
project_translation.output: A candidate synthesis whose individual edges are sourced and whose A↔C conclusion is labeled inference/hypothesis until independently tested.

rarity_contract.test: Could the reader have learned essentially the same thing from one ordinary encyclopedia page?
rarity_contract.pass: No; the value emerges from joining multiple sources, time layers or domains.

rarity_contract.test: Is there an explicit intermediate mechanism or relation rather than visual resemblance alone?
rarity_contract.pass: Yes; each bridge edge can be stated and sourced.

rarity_contract.test: Do at least two source communities or evidence streams contribute distinct information?
rarity_contract.pass: Yes; one source is not merely repeating the other.

rarity_contract.test: Does the synthesis explain something previously confusing, predict a place to look, or change how a question can be investigated?
rarity_contract.pass: Yes; it creates orientation rather than more ornament.

rarity_contract.test: Can evidence weaken, reject or revise the proposed connection?
rarity_contract.pass: Yes; the bridge declares what would break it.

rarity_contract.test: Does the insight improve a decision, research plan, interpretation, capability or next search?
rarity_contract.pass: Prefer yes; pure contemplation may still qualify when explanatory gain is substantial.

rarity_contract.test: Can the reader walk backward from synthesis to each source fragment and conversation origin?

discovery_modes.task: Search for B terms/mechanisms that legitimately connect both.
discovery_modes.example: Potatoverse Garden ↔ robust human/institutional flourishing: identify autonomy, capability, governance and resilience mechanisms shared across literatures.

discovery_modes.task: Extract consequential B mechanisms from A, then search for distant C domains where B is central.
discovery_modes.example: Door as conditional state transition → investigate border law, APIs, initiation, credit approval, biological membranes and phase transitions as distinct C domains, then retain only mechanism-valid relations.

discovery_modes.task: Find when separate formulations first become one concept and what information was lost or gained during compression.
discovery_modes.example: Conversation archaeology → repository canon → current interface.

discovery_modes.task: Traverse Spirit/Mind/Body plus funding, governance, infrastructure, history and dependencies to expose hidden leverage or mission contradiction.
discovery_modes.example: An institution's public mission may diverge from incentive, funding or capability structure; label this as a research question until evidence supports the gap.

discovery_modes.task: Ask what expected node/edge/evidence is consistently absent.
discovery_modes.example: Many claims about purpose but no evidence of autonomy, capability or downstream Fruit signals an important missing layer.

rejection_rules: Shared number without mechanism is not a bridge.
Shared shape without historical or functional relation is not a bridge.
Two metaphors that feel similar do not establish causal or historical connection.
A project symbol cannot be used as independent evidence for the external tradition it is being compared with.
A three-link story becomes weaker, not stronger, when any edge is unsupported.
Novelty is not evidence; surprising claims require at least the same evidentiary discipline as ordinary claims.

value_metric.formula: RareValue ≈ supported bridge × explanatory gain × provenance × testability × usefulness; if bridge support approaches zero, the product should approach zero regardless of how striking the analogy feels.
value_metric.boundary: This is a project heuristic, not a validated scientific metric.

integration_with_house.Bridge: new capability between previously separated bodies of knowledge
integration_with_house.Tree: branching consequences of a discovered connection
integration_with_house.Fruit: what the connection explains or enables
integration_with_house.Seed: a reusable hypothesis, method or research programme

outputs: corrections where a cherished symbolic link fails
new concrete population edges in the World Atlas
